task: K4 Day 9 - Multi-Agent E-commerce Dispute Resolution
framework: LiteLLM + custom Python orchestrator + pandas + pydantic

model_selection_rationale.coordinator: Most complex synthesis; final JSON assembly, orchestration, trace management
model_selection_rationale.policy: Most complex rule reasoning: taxonomy, responsibility, refund calc, action sequencing
model_selection_rationale.customer: Simple identity lookup + customer history; mechanical, low reasoning load
model_selection_rationale.payment: Payment aggregation + reconciliation; deterministic arithmetic via tools

design_principle: Do not trust the customer claim — join and verify all facts from CSV before applying policy
